extracted.intended_audience: manuscript referees for AEJ: Applied Economics (journal reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for referees reviewing manuscripts submitted to AEJ: Applied Economics, covering anonymity, conflict-of-interest treatment, evaluation focus, submission procedures, and recommended external resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-blind review / referee anonymity
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts submitted to the AEJ: Applied Economics are reviewed in a single-blind fashion. Because the referee(s) should remain anonymous to authors, we ask you not to use your name in the body or filename of your report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include your name anywhere in the review text or in the filename of the report you upload; preserve referee anonymity consistent with single-blind review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of disclosure statements and conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: All manuscript submissions are accompanied by individual disclosure statements from each coauthor. However, recommendations should not be based on whether potential conflicts of interest exist, but on whether the conclusions in the paper are robust, credible, and worthy of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although authors provide disclosure statements, reviewers should not let knowledge of potential conflicts drive their recommendation; focus assessment on the paper's substantive merits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation focus: robustness, credibility, and worthiness
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations should be based on whether the conclusions in the paper are robust, credible, and worthy of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When forming recommendations, evaluate (and comment on) the robustness of results (e.g., sensitivity, identification), the credibility of methods and assumptions, and whether the contribution merits publication in the journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural requirement: use ScholarOne Manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.description: The AEA uses ScholarOne Manuscripts for submission and peer review tracking. To see more information and instructions for submitting a review, log in and navigate to your Reviewer Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit your review through the ScholarOne system and follow the specific submission steps shown in your Reviewer Center (login required).

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended external referee-report guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage you to read the brief set of guidelines on referee reports prepared by Econometrica and the more detailed guidelines published in the Journal of Economic Perspectives by Jonathan Berk, Campbell Harvey, and David Hirshleifer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These external guidelines are suggested resources and 'do not represent official AEA policy, but you may find them helpful.' Reviewers can consult them for examples of good referee-report practices and structuring reviews.
